fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { givingTuesday: "Build a Giving Tuesday page for my food bank, Tallow Creek. The goal is $30,000 by midnight. A board member matches every gift from a $10,000 pool, so show each gift counting twice and show how much match is left. Take gifts through my Stripe account and save each one to a gifts table with the matched amount beside it.", volunteerShifts: "Make a signup page for my river cleanup this Saturday. I need two shifts of 20 volunteers, at 9 AM and 1 PM. Each volunteer picks a shift and accepts the waiver. When a shift reaches 20, take it off the page and show the spots left on the other one. Email both rosters to Teodora Ibarra, my coordinator, on Friday at 5 PM.", charity5k: "I need fundraising pages for our Quarry Street 5K. Every runner who registers gets a personal page with a $300 goal and a link to share. Gifts on a runner's page count toward that runner and the team. When a runner reaches the goal, mark it met on the page and email the runner a thank-you note.", yearEndAppeal: "Set up the gift page for my animal rescue's year-end letter. Each letter has a QR code for one donor that opens the page with their last gift already filled in. Save every gift with the appeal code MAIL-DEC. When a gift is $500 or more, send Ondine Bancroft, my director, a Slack message so she can plan a thank-you call." };

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: Mossgate Animal Rescue's year-end gift page saves a $650 gift with appeal code MAIL-DEC, and director Ondine Bancroft gets a Slack message because it is $500 or more.
